faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Ryujin. Can't find the answer? Reach out to our team.
faq.a1: Ryujin is a comprehensive personal finance and investment management platform. It helps you track income, expenses, debts, and investments while providing powerful analytics and projections to grow your wealth.
faq.a2: Absolutely. We use bank-grade AES-256 encryption for all data at rest and TLS 1.3 for data in transit. Your credentials are hashed with bcrypt, and we never store or share your data with third parties.
faq.q3: Can I track investments from different markets?
faq.a3: Yes! Ryujin supports real-time tracking of stocks, ETFs, and fixed income instruments from global markets. We pull data from Yahoo Finance and Alpha Vantage to give you comprehensive coverage.
faq.a4: Yes. Each account, income source, and investment can have its own currency. Ryujin automatically converts to your default currency for dashboard aggregations using regularly updated exchange rates.
faq.q5: Can I export my financial data?
faq.a5: Pro and Enterprise users can export their data in multiple formats including CSV and PDF. You retain full ownership of your data and can download it at any time.
faq.a6: Ryujin is built as a responsive web application that works beautifully on any device. A dedicated mobile app with push notifications for spending alerts is on our roadmap.
